contact.address: County Road 9, near Danforth, Voss County, Meridian 55—

intake.matter_summary: Farmer-owned dairy co-op seeks recovery against equipment seller Brandt Refrigeration Systems, LLC after a new $96,000 bulk milk-cooling unit failed to hold temperature three times in its first two months, spoiling milk. UCC Article 2 breach-of-warranty and remedies dispute; limited-remedy warranty disclaims consequential damages; mediation then binding arbitration contemplated per the agreement.
intake.referral_source: co-op board member referral (prior firm client)

conflicts_check.notes: No current or former representation of Brandt Refrigeration Systems, LLC, Sylvia Brandt, or Larkspur Creamery. Prior closed matter for this client (m22) reviewed; no positional conflict. Independent engineer Rask is a retained consultant, not adverse.

time_entries.narrative: Initial client interview with general manager Aaberg; scope, goals, and timeline of the three cooling failures.
Open matter; conflicts clearance; preliminary case assessment memo to file.
Review purchase agreement and limited warranty; research sale-of-goods warranty framework.
Draft warranty-claim analysis; outline demand and mediation posture.
Review draft analysis; client call with Aaberg to confirm loss figures and documents.
Gather and index delivery/installation, service, and creamery rejection records.
Interview milk-house operator Tuvang; build fact chronology of the three failures.
Research limited-remedy failure of essential purpose and consequential-damages exclusion.
Memorialize technician interview; assess mixed-causation evidence.
Confer with independent engineer Rask regarding inspection findings and report.
Draft mediation statement and damages model (spoilage, premium loss, cover costs).
Research enforceability of consequential-damages exclusion in commercial sale; unconscionability angle.
Client counseling call: mediation vs. arbitration, exposure, and best alternative.
Revise mediation statement; assemble exhibit set and witness summaries.
Correspondence to opposing counsel proposing mediation dates and scheduling.
Interview creamery grader Callahan; obtain rejection tickets and credit memos.
Review mediation package; strategy conference with associate.
Finalize mediation statement; client sign-off.
Prepare for mediation session; anticipate Brandt's causation and warranty-limit defenses.
Attend mediation session (part 1) with client representative.
Post-mediation analysis; draft settlement counter and outline arbitration statement of the case.
Client counseling on settlement counter versus proceeding to binding arbitration.
Research arbitration procedure and award-review standard; draft arbitration demand outline.
Correspondence with opposing counsel on settlement terms; evaluate offer.
Refine damages model with engineer input; prepare demand exhibits.
Strategy conference; assess mixed-causation risk for arbitration.
Draft statement of the case for binding arbitration; witness and exhibit list.
Client update on status and options; confirm next steps.
Finalize arbitration statement of the case and supporting damages summary.
